title: You Can't Reuse What You Can't Find
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A mock search for "watershed grade 6 reading open license" shows three resource records: one found and clear, one not found, and one found but unclear.

educational.topic: Why metadata decides whether a resource is found and trusted
learningObjectives: The learner will explain why a record with missing metadata is found, not found, or found but unclear for the same search.
prerequisites: The six core metadata fields from [Chapter 9](../../chapters/09-modularity-metadata/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Which fields does the search read?
What would a teacher still need to know?
commonMisconceptions: A good resource will be found by its title alone
Metadata is part of the content
assessmentOpportunities: Why is resource B not found by the search?
Why is resource C found but unclear?
Which six fields make up a core record?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Poster zones
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
